title: Add independent V45 frame and ledger audit
body:
## Summary

- Add a standard-library audit of PR #2979's V45 coordinated end-frame change for helpers 249, 251, 265 and 267.
- Independently rebuild the F2 frame walk, the complete stage-one local rank profile, both provider rank and width reports, owner schedule/fill checks, idle-inclusive 666-call rank histogram and physical-family invoice.
- Check all 15 nonempty V45 endpoint-subset profiles under the complete stage-one gate refit. The losing one-helper margin is −53,141 and the four-helper margin is +22,972 under the pinned group-price model.
- Bind the frozen source manifest and all 111 manifest-listed files; recheck the 12 allocation pins contained in that set. Reject five semantic failure controls.
- PR #3823 records the V45 triple intersection and PR #3841 records the printed margin ladder. This package adds the independent frame/profile and complete ledger reconstruction; it does not claim an independent derivation of the search-time V45 group price.

No new κ or selected-frontier change is claimed.

## Verification

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/independent-v45-ledger-audit --check-only
# PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS (not a mathematical acceptance check)

\
  python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/independent-v45-ledger-audit
# PASS_INDEPENDENT_V45_FRAME_COST_AND_PHYSICAL_LEDGER
# PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE ... outcome=partial

python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py \
  --package research/independent-v45-ledger-audit
# PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES; 118 files
```

## Limits

The subset margins use the pinned V45 joint price row. A V45-only gate-edit decomposition of the parent is nonmonotone at register 169, so no independent group-only price or frame-search optimality claim is made. The two guards are the residual in the pinned owner invoice. The package does not run the registered full frontier replay, native-provider replay, fresh algebra replay, outer proof or supplier admission. The optional source-history publication check could not run because the worktree does not contain full Git history; committed-byte verification passed.

## Credit

PR #2979 and its predecessor/source lineage retain their original attribution: Marius-Paul Dumitrean (#2979), Mason Hale (#2917), Jeremy Kothe (#2957), and PR #2942 with its cited predecessors. This audit was prepared with OpenAI Codex assistance; separate human and formal-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Publication validation

The registered package replay passed on CPython 3.12.3 with `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/independent-v45-ledger-audit`. The optional `--check-source-history` preflight could not run because this MacBook checkout is shallow and the checker requires full Git history. This package's source manifest pins only files at its exact base commit `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`; it contains no `head:` source pins. Any earlier pending note above refers to the state before this publication-time replay.
